question: Name the project which was launched for tackling the increasing HIV prevalence in the eight North-Eastern states.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Project Sunrise__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Project Sunrise:

 
 
• This five-year project has been launched by JP Nadda for the prevention of AIDS in people with drug-injecting habits in eight Northeastern states.
 
• Project Sunrise will complement the already existing National AIDS Control Programme.
 
• It aims to improve the coverage, quality, and scale of HIV control measures being taken up.
 
• It will be funded by the CDC (USA) and will be implemented in coordination with state AIDS control organizations and other NGOs.
 
• The project will focus on identifying about 90% of drug addicts with HIV and starting their treatment.
 
• The project will follow a data-driven approach to reach out to the target population.
 
• A GIS-based real-time monitoring system will be developed to track the data service delivery points.
 
• Central, State, and district-level prisons will also be covered.
 
 
 
• AIDS:
 
 
• It is a syndrome caused by a virus termed HIV (human immunodeficiency virus).
 
• This virus affects the immune system in humans and makes them much more vulnerable to infections and diseases.
 
• It is a disease that progresses initially for a long period of time without any symptoms.
 
• When the HIV virus attacks the T-cells in the immune system, it makes your body weak symptoms like a headache, fever, sore joints, and muscles, etc. start appearing. When AIDS remains unattended, it leads to death.
 
 
 
• HIV (human immunodeficiency virus) is a virus that attacks cells in the body that help it battle infections, making a person more susceptible to other infections and diseases.
 
• The human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) is thus a virus that affects the immune system of the body.
 
• HIV is a member of a group of viruses called Retrovirus.
 
• Retrovirus is the type of RNA, which replicates itself into the host organism to produce viral DNA.
 
• This viral DNA gets incorporated inside the DNA of the host and thus leads to the multiplication of many viral DNAs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mission Sampark**

 
 
• "Mission Sampark" was introduced in **2017**.
 
• The initiative was launched to bring back People Living with HIV who have left treatment after starting Anti Retroviral Treatment (ART).
 
• It aligns with the National Strategic Plan to achieve the 90:90:90 strategy, a narrative of the UNAIDS program for a new HIV treatment.
 
• The specific goal is to track individuals missing out on Antiretroviral Therapy (ART) and reintegrate them into the system.
 
• The Minister of Health in India addressed the success of this HIV Prevention Model in November 2020 at a Ministerial meeting of the Global.
